title: Verify the 'Auto-apply to all new work orders at this location' checkbox adds the template to every new work order at that location
custom_preconds: 1. You can create a template and then a new work order at the same location.
custom_steps:
1. Create a template 'ZZAUTOTEST Auto Fee' (Fee, Flat Amount, $10.00, taxable) with the 'Auto-apply to all new work orders at this location' checkbox turned on.
2. Create a new work order at that location.
3. Open the 'Work Order Fees & Discounts' card on the work order.
custom_expected:
1. The checkbox in the template dialog is labelled 'Auto-apply to all new work orders at this location', shown as a checkbox with the caption 'When on, this fee / discount is added automatically to every new work order created at this location. It can still be edited or removed on individual work orders.'.
2. The new work order automatically has a whole-work-order fee 'ZZAUTOTEST Auto Fee' = +$10.00.
3. The added fee copies the template's name, type, method, amount, taxable and Max Amount as they were when the work order was created.
